title: The Final Exam Strategy
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: The Final Exam Strategy. Locally generated synthetic English speech.

transcript.text: I used to listen for every single word, and whenever I missed one, I would stop following the rest of the recording. My tutor suggested reading the questions first and listening for the speaker’s main point. Since then, I have become better at recognising paraphrases, even when the recording uses different words from the answer options. I still find long recordings challenging, but I no longer panic when I miss a detail.
